notes.title: Column on the Sea version 1.2 released
notes.notes:
Column on the Sea has been updated to version 1.2. This a small patch that fixes some audio related bugs and adds a frequently requested feature.

+Added the ability to toggle Auto Running. This option can be toggled from the pause menu, and when enabled, will allow you to run without holding the run button/key. (Holding the run button with Auto Running turned on will cause you to walk at normal speed).
+Fixed a rare bug where certain sound effects  would not play correctly.

notes.title: Column on the Sea Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 of Column on the Sea has been released today. This is a small update that fixes a few minor graphical errors.

+Fixed an issue involving the clouds on the title screen
+Fixed an issue with the words "Magic Trial Begin!" before a magic trial
+Fixed an issue with the game over screen
+Fixed an issue with the end credits
